spec.description: pickle, reverse GitOps for Kubernetes: what it mirrors to Git, its pushes, its watches on the API, Secret encryption and its own runtime. Pick data source, then cluster.

spec.title: Last Push
spec.description: Time since the last successful push. A quiet cluster pushes rarely; that is normal. Push Failures says whether something is wrong.

spec.title: Objects Tracked
spec.description: Objects mirrored in the repo right now.

spec.title: Changes in Range
spec.description: Object files written or removed in the time range.

spec.title: Commits in Range
spec.description: Commits pickle pushed in the time range. Changes that settle together become one commit.

spec.title: Push Failures in Range
spec.description: Fetch, commit or push cycles that failed and were retried. Changes are kept until a push works.

spec.title: Backfill
spec.description: Share of resource types listed since pickle started. Live changes are captured from the start either way.

spec.title: Types Watched
spec.description: Resource types pickle watches.

spec.title: Unreadable Types
spec.description: Discovered types pickle can't read, listed with the reason in <cluster>/_unreadable.txt.

spec.title: Resyncs in Range
spec.description: Full relists after a watch expired (410 Gone). A few are normal; many mean pickle keeps losing its watches.

spec.title: Secret Values
spec.description: How Secret values are written to Git: masked (****), or encrypted to your certificate (enc:).

spec.title: Memory Held
spec.description: Memory the pickle container really holds (cAdvisor rss): the number to size the limit against.

spec.expr: max(container_memory_rss{container="pickle"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.title: Version
spec.description: Version of the running pickle.

spec.title: Changes per Minute
spec.description: Object files written (created or changed) and removed.

spec.title: Commits per Hour
spec.description: Commits pushed, and failed or conflicting push cycles.

spec.title: Objects Tracked
spec.description: Objects mirrored in the repo.

spec.title: Time Since Last Push
spec.description: Grows while the cluster is quiet and drops at every push. Only failures need attention.

spec.title: Last Push
spec.description: Time since the last successful push. A quiet cluster pushes rarely; that is normal. Push Failures says whether something is wrong.

spec.title: Commits in Range
spec.description: Commits pickle pushed in the time range. Changes that settle together become one commit.

spec.title: Push Failures in Range
spec.description: Fetch, commit or push cycles that failed and were retried. Changes are kept until a push works.

spec.title: Push Conflicts in Range
spec.description: Pushes that found another cluster had pushed to the branch first. Pickle pushes again on top; nothing is lost.

spec.title: Files Written in Range
spec.description: Object files created or changed.

spec.title: Files Removed in Range
spec.description: Object files removed because their object was deleted or excluded.

spec.title: Pushes
spec.description: Commits pushed per hour.

spec.title: Push Failures and Conflicts
spec.description: Failed cycles are retried with backoff, up to 5 minutes apart. Conflicts are handled by pushing again on top.

spec.title: Files Written and Removed
spec.description: Object files per minute.

spec.title: Time Since Last Push
spec.description: Grows while the cluster is quiet and drops at every push.

spec.title: Types Watched
spec.description: Resource types pickle watches.

spec.title: Unreadable Types
spec.description: Discovered types pickle can't read, listed with the reason in <cluster>/_unreadable.txt.

spec.title: Backfill
spec.description: Share of resource types listed since pickle started. Live changes are captured from the start either way.

spec.title: Watch Reconnects in Range
spec.description: Watches reopened from their last position. Normal: every 30 to 60 minutes per type.

spec.title: Resyncs in Range
spec.description: Full relists after a watch expired (410 Gone).

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Live goroutines: about one per watched type.

spec.title: Backfill Progress
spec.description: Resource types listed so far, of all types to list. The backfill is slow on purpose.

spec.title: Watch Reconnects and Resyncs per Hour
spec.description: Reconnects are routine. Resyncs relist a whole type; a steady stream of them is the problem to look at.

spec.title: Types Watched and Unreadable
spec.description: New CRDs are picked up within seconds. Unreadable types are listed in _unreadable.txt.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: About one per watched type, plus a few.

spec.title: Secret Values
spec.description: How Secret values are written to Git: masked (****), or encrypted to your certificate (enc:).

spec.title: Values Encrypted in Range
spec.description: New or changed Secret values encrypted. Unchanged values keep their line and cost nothing.

spec.title: Encryption Failures in Range
spec.description: Values that couldn't be encrypted and were written masked (****:<fingerprint>) instead. Never written in plain. The log names each one.

spec.title: Values Encrypted, All Time
spec.description: Since pickle started. Turning encryption on, or a new certificate, encrypts every value once.

spec.title: Values Encrypted per Minute
spec.description: Spikes at startup after turning encryption on or changing the certificate, then only when a value changes.

spec.title: Encryption Failures
spec.description: Values written masked because they couldn't be encrypted.

spec.title: Version
spec.description: Version of the running pickle.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since pickle started.

spec.title: Restarts in Range
spec.description: Times pickle started in the time range.

spec.title: Memory Held
spec.description: Memory the pickle container really holds (cAdvisor rss): the number to size the limit against.

spec.expr: max(container_memory_rss{container="pickle"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.title: Live Heap
spec.description: Go heap held by live objects after the last GC.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU cores pickle uses (cAdvisor). Its limit is half a core.

spec.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="pickle"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.title: Process Status
spec.description: The pickle process: version, uptime, memory really held (rss), live Go heap and CPU as a share of one core (cAdvisor).

spec.expr: time() - max by (pod, version) (pickle_start_time_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (version) pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})
max by (pod) (container_memory_rss{container="pickle"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="pickle"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.title: Memory by Kind
spec.description: rss: memory the container really holds. working set: what kubectl top shows; it also counts page cache. heap live: Go objects in use. mapped and released: the Go runtime's view.

spec.expr: max(container_memory_rss{container="pickle"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
max(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="pickle"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.title: CPU (share of one core)
spec.description: CPU cores pickle uses (cAdvisor). Bursts during backfill, relists and pushes; near zero when the cluster is quiet.

spec.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="pickle"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () group by (namespace, pod) (pickle_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.description: Prometheus or Mimir data source with pickle's metrics (and cAdvisor, for memory and CPU).
